name: Mastera Osu Online
source:
Mastera Osu Online is a visual novel with famous Osu players.
The plot is that several osu! players are testing a special development vr helmet from a man with the nickname xxdstem. It turns out this evil developer has made a device that transports them into a deadly game where players must fight each other. Also in another world they gain special superpowers.
translation:
Mastera Osu Online是一款由著名Osu玩家创作的视觉小说。
剧情就是那几个osu！玩家们正在测试一个绰号为xxdstem的男子开发的特殊VR头盔。事实证明，这个邪恶的开发者制造了一种设备，可以将他们传送到一个致命的游戏中，玩家必须互相战斗。同样在另一个世界他们获得了特殊的超能力。
